units.source_text: 我一人受羞辱，在旅馆的温泉里用温泉水洗了洗几乎要哭的脸。

en.t: I alone bore the humiliation, and in the inn's hot spring I washed my face, which was almost on the verge of tears, with the hot spring water.

units.source_text: 友子挂着一副严肃的面孔，走进了澡堂。

en.t: Tomoko came into the bathhouse wearing a serious expression.

units.source_text: 她把脱下的衣服乱扔在一边，在浴池边咕噜噜转圈。

en.t: She flung the clothes she had taken off to one side and spun round and round beside the bath.
